subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps - Acme Health

Hi Priya / Sanjay —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Wanted to capture the key points and proposed plan so we have alignment before we kick off the pilot. TL;DR: Redwood will run a 6-week Pilot (POC) focused on improving clinical note summarization and triage accuracy using your internal dataset and our hosted dedicated environment.

1) Pain points / goals (as we heard):
- Inconsistent summarization quality across specialties (ED / Cardiology / Oncology)
- High time spent by clinicians reviewing long notes (goal: reduce avg review time by 30%)
- Need measurable improvements on recall for critical findings (reduce missed-critical by 40%)

2) Proposed Pilot scope:
- Dataset: ~25k de-identified notes across ED & Cardiology (sample set from Acme)
- Models & prompts: 1 baseline open model + 2 tuned prompt sets for summarization + a reranker for triage priority
- Environment: Redwood Dedicated (isolated pool) with audit logs enabled
- Duration: 6 weeks active testing (plus 1 week prep)

3) Success metrics / evaluation (we'll instrument the following):
- Clinical summarization accuracy (human eval F1 on labeled set) — target +15% over baseline
- Avg clinician review time — target -30%
- Critical-find recall — target +40%
- Latency/SLA: p95 generation latency < 850ms for 512-token runs

4) Prompt set / eval plan:
- We'll start with the prompt bundle we demoed; Dev will produce a canonical prompt set and an A/B eval harness.
- Redwood will run automated evals on a held-out prompt set and provide an evaluation dashboard weekly.

5) Owners / roles:
- Acme: Priya Desai (Product lead) — primary POC owner; Sanjay Gupta (Clinical SME); Michael O'Leary (IT / network) — pending add
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM, pilot lead); Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer, technical onboarding & evals); Sean Gallagher (Customer Success, adoption metrics); Laura Bennett (Security & compliance support)

6) Timeline / milestones:
- Week 0 (this week): access & network setup, SOW sign, data sample upload (requested 5/25k notes)
- Week 1: technical onboarding + baseline eval on initial sample
- Weeks 2-5: iterative tuning and weekly evals; incorporate clinician feedback
- Week 6: final evaluation, ROI summary, recommendation for production rollout

7) Access / setup steps we need from Acme (please action or point us to who can):
- Share de-identified sample dataset (SFTP link or Drive) + schema
- Provide service account or IP allowlist for Redwood Dedicated endpoints
- Confirm data retention policy & required audit settings (we'll default to 90 days unless you ask otherwise)

Attachments: Acme_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), redwood-poc-access-instructions.txt (network & service account checklist)

Next steps (proposed):
- Priya / Sanjay: confirm scope & owners and share IT contact for access (Michael O'Leary or equivalent)
- I'll send draft SOW for signature and schedule a 60-minute technical onboarding with Dev + Michael next week (proposed Wed 10am PT)

Happy to adjust. Thanks again — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
